items.name: Play a game of Rummy
items.about: Build sets and runs from your hand of 13 cards. One of India's best-loved family card games.
howToSteps: Get a standard deck (or the game's own cards) and a few players.
Learn what counts as a pure sequence first.
Play one full game, start to finish.
